about: Whether a PodDisruptionBudget can ever allow an eviction, as both halves read it: cannot_allow in src/tauri/src/resources/disruption.rs (the connections facts every governance reader takes, and Audit's pdb-blocks-disruption rule) and cannotAllowOf in src/ui/lib/governance.ts (the budget's own page and peek, which read the raw object). It cannot when the pods it selects number at least one and every one of them is required healthy: with all of them up there is still none to spare, so a drain waits on it for good. A budget that selects nothing is a different finding, not this one.
